top_signals.title: US Bank Earnings Put FICC Sales & Trading in Focus
top_signals.summary: Wall Street banks kicked off earnings season Tuesday with third-quarter results from JPMorgan Chase & Co., Goldman Sachs Group Inc., Citigroup Inc., and Wells Fargo & Co. Christopher McGratty, head of US bank research at KBW, examines the results on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
